viewing_check: Look for maker and model stamps on the tank, burner and hood (Tilley with model number, Primus, Optimus, Monitor, Aladdin). Check tanks for dents or leaks, pump present, intact generator and glass, and whether the spare guard fits either. Photograph the tank base and the fuel cap.
